title: AWS WAF: filtering web requests at layer 7

kcs.statement: AWS WAF is a layer 7 web application firewall. Rules in a web ACL filter HTTP(S) requests, for example to block SQL injection or cross-site scripting, block specific IP addresses or countries, or rate-limit clients.
WAF protects web front doors such as CloudFront distributions, Application Load Balancers and API Gateway APIs. It cannot be attached to a Network Load Balancer or directly to an EC2 instance.
